name: qbcam
description: QBCAM — real-time AI face swap, virtual webcam & studio recorder

scripts.test:py: uv run --project services/vision pytest -q && uv run --project services/media pytest -q
scripts.fmt: biome check --write . && ruff format services tools
scripts.drift:guard: bun run contracts:gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/dist || (echo 'CONTRACT DRIFT: run bun run contracts:gen and commit' && exit 1)
